y70mfpdm.baseName: Walplus 300 Warm LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
y70mfpdm.variantName: Walplus 300 Warm LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
y70mfpdm.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree redefines seasonal decor with its sleek, cone-shaped form and warm LED lights that evoke a sense of modern elegance. Combining practicality with style, this seasonal must-have is perfect for adding a touch of sophistication to any space, whether indoors or out, making it a versatile centerpiece for homes and offices alike. Durable Materials: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree presents a lifelike appearance while ensuring durability and long-lasting use. The metal framework provides stability, supporting the tree's structure perfectly and maintaining its shape through multiple festive seasons. This combination of materials makes it both robust and visually appealing. USB Electric Connectivity: This tree includes a USB plug connection that conveniently powers the LED strip lights, eliminating the need for traditional power outlets. The easy plug-and-play setup enhances usability, allowing for effortless installation and repositioning within any space throughout the holiday season. Warm White LED Lights: A timeless choice for Christmas decorations, the LED strip lights emit a soft, warm glow to create an inviting atmosphere. These energy-efficient lights are not only visually stunning but also ensure consistent illumination without overheating, making them safe for daily use and family-friendly gatherings. Indoor and Outdoor Placement: This artificial tree is suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, offering versatility in decoration locations. Its adaptable design allows it to grace living rooms, terraces, and gardens, providing festive charm in various environments with minimal maintenance. Care &Storage Tips: For optimal maintenance, cover the tree when not in use and store it in a dry, cool place after the holiday. Regular care ensures its vibrant appearance and functionality over years, allowing you to enjoy festive moments time and again without the hassle of annual tree purchases. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and steel and plastic Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 55 cm Durable With Thick Branches Lifelike Tips Number of PVC tips: 435 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

gwp8nhxj.variantName: Outsunny 8FT Christmas Inflatable Gingerbread Man with Candy Cane - Orange
gwp8nhxj.sourceDescription: Christmas made extra fun? Yes please. Do it, this season and beyond, with this Outsunny inflatable gingerbread man with a candy cane and three gift bags. The polyester shell makes this a tough piece, which is also IP44 rated for mild water resistance - it's suitable for use in mild rain outdoors. Inside there are six white LED lights - this inflatable gingerbread man glows and sparkles to bring the night alive, this season and beyond. ● Great design for Christmas: Gingerbread man with a candy cane and three gift bags ● Inner white LED lights to glow at night ● Plug into the mains to inflate and set up. Turn off to deflate ● IP44 rated polyester shell is safe in mild rain. Suitable for outdoor use ● Six ground stakes, two guy ropes and two sandbags included to pin and stabilise to the ground Primary Colour: Orange Type: Inflatable Gingerbread Man with Candy Cane and Three Gift Bags Material: Polyester Cloth Overall Dimension: 170W x 100D x 245Hcm Overall Height: 8ft Cord Length: 3(m) LED Light Count: 6 LED Light Power: 0.5W Fan: DC 12V, 1.0A Input Voltage: AC 220-240V, 50/60Hz Output Voltage: DC 12V, 1.25A Certification: IP44 Item Label: 844-964V70OG NOTE: Blower needs to be plugged in to keep outdoor Christmas decoration full. Do not leave plugged in for more than eight hours. Do not use in heavy rain, snow or wind Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
